name: אֶלָּסָר
summary: Ellasar is the place ruled by Arioch, listed with Shinar and Elam in the titles of the kings of Genesis 14:1. Its derivation is unknown.

evidence.note: The title מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּסָר identifies Arioch by the place he rules.

note: Moved from the former word entry `2aellaasaar`. The old root key אלסר recorded the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is unknown.
